name: Ramkaran kumhar ki medbandi(Peepal wala khet me)
Bhaure lal kumhar ki medbandi nahari wala khet ki
hamatkari bala ji talai (mandir ke samane)
chamatkari bala ji talai (mandir ke pichhe)
Bhagawan sahay mina ka anicut (Nyali nala pr)
Doongar tal ka bandh(Bhagwan, Sahay, Sugga ka)
Po ki ghati ka bandh(Gopaj me)
Bans ka tola ka bandh(Rameshwar,Prabhu ka)
Rudaram ka bandh(Keetala ki Radi me)
Dhamlala me khar ki talai(Sanjaynath ji ki talai)
Hari singh ka anicut(Aama ka veda me)
Kishana ji ki (dabali wale khet ki medbandi)
Kundalya ka anicut (Ninjhar ki ghati me)
Ramrahe ka pagara (Kallu gurjar ka)-pucca kary
